task: Fix TruckConnect Map Rendering Issue (Gray Canvas, No OpenStreetMap Tiles)

context.symptom: Map shows gray background with markers visible but no roads or labels
context.environment: Protected route (/map), Socket.io active, Geolocation enabled

root_cause_priority: Mixed content (HTTP tiles on HTTPS origin)
SSR conflict in Next.js App Router

sub_agents.name: ReactLeafletTileLayerAgent
sub_agents.objective: Ensure OpenStreetMap TileLayer is correctly configured in react-leaflet
actions: Ensure TileLayer component exists inside MapContainer
Replace any http:// tile URL with https://

sub_agents.name: LeafletGlobalCSSAgent
sub_agents.objective: Ensure Leaflet CSS is globally imported in App Router
actions: If missing, inject into app/layout.tsx or root client entry
Ensure it loads before map renders

sub_agents.name: NextAppRouterSSRGuardAgent
sub_agents.objective: Prevent SSR from breaking Leaflet rendering
actions: Ensure map component is marked 'use client'
If not, add 'use client' at top
If dynamic import used, ensure ssr:false
Ensure map initialization only happens in client context

sub_agents.name: MapContainerLayoutAgent
sub_agents.objective: Ensure map container has proper dimensions in Tailwind layout
actions: Inject Tailwind class h-screen or h-[100vh]
Ensure parent containers are not height:0

sub_agents.name: HTTPSMixedContentAgent
sub_agents.objective: Prevent tile blocking when running over ngrok HTTPS
actions: Check if NEXTAUTH_URL or app origin is HTTPS

sub_agents.name: NetworkDiagnosticsAgent
sub_agents.objective: Verify tile PNG requests are successful

verification_procedure: Confirm PNG tiles load with status 200
Confirm roads and place names visible
Confirm markers render on top of tiles
